There is a land card in your library that can be fetched using Myriad Landscape.
There are two basic land cards in your library that share a basic land type.
1479-2841-6517-8106.description:
Fetch a land using Myriad Landscape.
When the fetched land enters, Dragonback Assault and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Kodama and Dragonback Assault trigger.
Holding priority, activate Ghost Town's first abiltiy by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Dragonback Assault from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Dragonback Assault triggers.
Repeat from step 5.

When Herd Baloth enters, the effect that adds +1/+1 counters to entering creatures triggers or applies its replacement effect, putting at least one +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters, that same effect causes you to place at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Yuna triggers, putting at least one +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth
Repeat steps 3 and 4 once.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat from step 5.

1494-5435-7720-7811.description:
If you have six or more cards in hand, activate Dream Trawler by discarding a card.
Repeat step 1 until you have five or fewer cards in hand.
At the beginning of your end step, The Ten Rings triggers, causing you to draw cards until you have ten cards in your hand.
Iron Man triggers for each card drawn, putting that many +1/+1 counters on Sage of Hours.
Activate Sage of Hours by removing all +1/+1 counters from it, causing you to take at least one extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

676-3259-5223.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached and Magnus the Red, triggering Breath of Fury and Magnus the Red.
Resolve the Magnus the Red trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

1619-2292-4605-5542-6149.notablePrerequisites: You are able to complete a dungeon.
1619-2292-4605-5542-6149.description:
Complete a dungeon.
Sefris' second ability triggers twice due to Delney.
Resolve the first trigger, returning up to one other creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the second trigger, returning Stirring Bard from your graveyard onto the battlefield.
When Stirring Bard enters, it and Preston trigger twice due to Delney.
Holding priority, activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Stirring Bard.
Resolve a Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Stirring Bard that is a 0/1 Illusion.
When the Stirring Bard token enters, it triggers twice due to Delney.
Resolve the Stirring Bard token triggers, venturing into Undercity twice.
Resolve the second Preston trigger from step 5, creating a token copy of Stirring Bard that is a 0/1 Illusion.
Repeat steps 8 and 9 one additional time.
Resolve the first Stirring Bard trigger from step 5, venturing into Undercity and completing Undercity.
Repeat from step 2.
1619-2292-4605-5542-6149.notes: You can choose whatever path you desire while venturing through Undercity.

Invisible Woman triggers, creating a 0/4 Wall creature token.
When the Wall enters, Hinterland Sanctifier triggers, causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 2.
6097-6824-7690.notes: The +1/+1 counter can be placed on any Hero you control except Invisible Woman. Spider-Man is used above for simplicity.

Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.

4067-7713.easyPrerequisites: You have a card in hand.
4067-7713.notablePrerequisites: You've discarded two or more cards this turn.
4067-7713.description:
Activate Misty by paying {2}, tapping it and discarding a card, causing you to draw a card for each card you've discarded this turn.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding a card, untapping Misty.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding a card, untapping a mana-producing permanent.
Activate the permanent by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Repeat from step 3 one additional time if you don't have {2} or more in your mana pool.
Repeat from step 1.
4067-7713.notes: If you control a permanent that taps to produce {2} or more, you can start the combo having only discarded one card this turn. You can also forego some or all of the discards by untapping Misty and supplementing mana until you draw enough cards each loop.

2974-3942-4377.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast a creature spell using Karador this turn.

Cast Repository Skaab either from your hand or from your graveyard by paying {3}{U}.
When Repository Skaab enters, its exploit ability triggers, causing you to sacrifice it.
Repository Skaab's second ability triggers, returning Walk the Aeons from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat each turn.

Resolve the The Destined White Mage trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control 
Repeat from step 3.

Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing the earthbent land.
When the land dies, Golgari Germination and Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger.
Resolve the Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Golgari Germination trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat.

1765-5972-6797.notablePrerequisites:

When the Aura enters the battlefield, Chishiro triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Repeat.

Activate The Peregrine Dynamo by paying {1} and tapping it, copying Tezzeret's ability, targeting Sisay's Ring and The Peregrine Dynamo.
Resolve the copy of Tezzeret's ability, untapping Sisay's Ring and The Peregrine Dynamo.
Repeat from step 2.

Murderous Redcap dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness.

When Ugin's Nexus is sacrificed, it is exiled instead of being put into your graveyard, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.

Cast Rograkh from the command zone by paying {0}.

When Rograkh enters the command zone, both copies of Myth Unbound trigger, causing you to draw two cards.
Resolve the Yahenni, Undying Partisan ability from step 3.
Repeat from step 2.

Resolve the first trigger, choosing not to pay.
Resolve the second trigger, causing you to pay {2} to deal two damage to an opponent.
Repeat from step 3.

1082-2729-4050.description:

Dual Nature's second ability triggers, and the Sylvan Hierophant token triggers.
Resolve the Sylvan Hierophant token's trigger, returning the nontoken Sylvan Hierophant to your hand.

Resolve the nontoken Sylvan Hierophant's trigger, returning a creature card from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

Holding priority, activate Skirge Familiar by discarding Corpse Dance, adding {B}.
Repeat from step 3.
